Use null or "not_stated" when the posting does not state a fact. Do not infer. Do not compare with any person. Return JSON only.

POSTING D00:
Receptionist - Bishan
Full-time, on-site. S$2,300 per month. Start in 1 month.
Requirements:
- Pleasant manner on the phone.
- Knowledge of MS Word is preferred.

Do not list duties, pay or benefits as requirements.
